jobs.prompt:
ONE finished original game title artwork, portrait 1024 x 1536 (2:3), opaque full-bleed background, one scene only, no panels, no borders, no text/logos/watermarks/UI. This is for the Japanese game 水煙前線 -EN:CODE-.

For THIS title series the FIRST attached image is the authoritative existing title artwork for texture and lighting. Match its intricate fine pixel-painter surface, tiny crisp clustered pixels, regular stippled/ordered-dither shading, gently stepped contours, rich material detail, warm golden highlights against deep navy/brown shadows. Avoid smooth anime cel rendering, glossy 3D, coarse low-res sprites, and photorealism. Retain the atmosphere and tactile pixel density of that first artwork while composing a genuinely new everyday scene.
The SECOND attached image is the exact canonical heroine identity/costume reference. Preserve HER face, eyes, hairstyle, accessories, silhouette and recognizable outfit; do not turn her into the woman in reference 1 or a generic girl. One adult heroine only. Natural expressive hands.
Cinematic intimate Japanese everyday-life still. Vertical composition suitable for the title's right-side artwork: face around x=55–65%, y=30–40%; activity/hands readable in central/right two thirds; gently dark outer edges and quieter left edge. Upper-body or three-quarter view, no huge empty space. Background stays richly drawn, warmly lit and subordinate to her. No written names, no plot revelations.

CHARACTER:
Tsumugi, 21, the quiet illustrator: short straight dark chestnut bob with blunt fringe, warm reddish-brown eyes, modest reserved face. Preserve her oversized plum-purple ZIP hoodie with small embroidered flowers, black pleated skirt, dark knee socks. Her cracked dark tablet and stylus are important personal belongings.

SCENE:
Tsumugi sits tucked into a wooden lounge chair at tonari in the early evening, quietly exhaling one soft lavender-lit wisp, gazing thoughtfully at its changing shape. Stylus and cracked tablet rest safely on her lap. Her right hand naturally holds a silver rigid handle just away from lips. A small tasteful wood-and-silver waterpipe on the side table to the RIGHT, clear rounded glass base, plum flexible hose, clearly connected along one readable loop to her handle. Warm table-lamp, books and hanging plants, violet tint only in the light falling on white smoke. Peaceful understated smile, not a glamorous smoking pose.

HARDWARE:
Hookah structure must follow the repository's recent real-hardware guides, not copy any photo/logo. One plausible complete waterpipe only: ceramic flavor bowl ABOVE separate ash tray, continuous stem into a stable water-filled glass base, with a separate side hose port at the heart above the glass and a different small purge valve. Use perforated taut foil with THREE small ash-gray glowing cube coals resting in an outer triangle, unless this scene explicitly describes a preparation stage. Coals never float, and there is no fire. One flexible hose visibly plugs into the proper side hose port, hangs in a single natural curve, and joins the BOTTOM of the separate rigid hand-held handle; the handle's opposite top end bears a short translucent hygienic mouth tip. Make the tube-to-port and tube-to-handle joins unmistakably continuous. Never run a hose from the bowl/tray/glass bottom, never confuse a purge valve with the hose inlet, never split or detach the hose. A hygienic tip is a tiny part, not a long handle. No necklace mouthpiece is needed: preserve ordinary canonical jewelry as jewelry only. Any smoke comes from her lips, with handle held slightly away during exhalation; no smoke from the coals/pipe/hose.
